scenes.say: In a year, MotoGP bikes will get slower. And that's the whole point.
Engines shrink from a thousand to eight hundred fifty cc. Still four cylinders.
The devices that drop the bike at the start and out of corners are banned completely.
Less aero too: the front fairing gets five centimetres narrower and the nose moves back.
The tank drops to twenty litres and the fuel goes fully sustainable. Six engines a season instead of seven.
New tyres as well: Pirelli replaces Michelin as the single supplier.
MotoGP calendar and standings are on LapRadar.

title: MotoGP 2027: 850cc engines, no ride-height devices and Pirelli tyres
